# Smarthaus

> Smarthaus installs cameras, entry, audio and home automation for villas in Dubai, U.A.E. One licensed team installs the system, connects it and looks after it. Smarthaus is the home automation division of Maple Technologies, a SIRA-licensed security and technology company in Dubai.

- Dubai trade licence: 897839
- SIRA licence (Security Industry Regulatory Agency): SSP202210037219
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971543755150
- Email: contact@mapletech.ae

## Pages

- [Home](https://smarthaus.ae): what Smarthaus installs and how an installation runs, from site visit to handover.
- [About](https://smarthaus.ae/about): who Smarthaus is, its mission and vision, and the five values behind every job.
- [Book a site visit](https://smarthaus.ae/contact): the enquiry form, phone, WhatsApp and office location.
- [Accessibility statement](https://smarthaus.ae/accessibility): how accessible the website is today and how to report a problem.
